capabilities: capture text copied to the clipboard while Obsidian runs
search clipboard history in real time
paste past clipboard entries via a quick paste modal
copy back or delete stored clipboard entries
export clipboard history to Markdown files
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); does not work on mobile and captures only text, not images or files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to recall previously copied text, so clipboard contents are lost once overwritten.
summary: Clipboard history manager that records copied text in Obsidian, searches it in real time, and pastes or exports past entries.
